The '''Mobile Defense Forces''' were Astorian military formations used to secure captured territory during the [[Bakorian War]].

== Role ==

The Bakorian War source describes Astorian operations as a combination of rapid breakthroughs by the [[Janissary Corps]] and consolidation by the Mobile Defense Forces. Their tasks included securing captured areas, protecting logistics, and reducing the ability of Bakorian guerrilla forces to disrupt supply lines.

== Strategic Importance ==

The forces made Astorian offensives more durable. Rather than relying only on rapid attacks, Astoria could hold captured areas, reopen roads, and turn battlefield gains into permanent control.
